Animal travel arrangements should feel steady and clear from check-in through boarding.  

Companion Animal Travel Desk - Incident and Boarding Compliance.  
Purpose: This section sets the rules for how Aurelia Skyways staff coordinate pet travel handling.

For boarding, the process requires form FM-597 completed before the cabin team takes over monitoring. Keep the companion animal record attached to the traveler file and verify the carrier tags match the itinerary labels at the desk counter. When the traveler arrives with Coco, confirm the animal’s readiness in a calm, professional tone, and escalate any concern immediately to the cabin supervisor so the flight team can maintain safe supervision.

For incident reporting, notify the Claim Adjudicator without delay after any disruption involving the animal or its carrier during skyport time or onboard handling. The senior coordinator on the shift will log the event in the desk system in plain language and include who was present, what actions were taken, and what outcome was observed before the next segment begins. If the traveler reports a concern, listen first, then capture the facts right away and do not let emotions delay documentation. The cabin team monitor should provide a quick summary to the desk so the report captures observations made during the flight window.

If Samuel Svensson or Nora Khan raises a question at the desk, direct them to the documented travel path and make sure the companion animal information stays consistent across every record before the traveler proceeds to the gate area. For help with live cases, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk via the shift coordinator channel.
